environment: Live Owner MQTT broker and PostgreSQL smart_workflow
commands: psql direct command snapshot before and after each ACK
mqtt pub SUCCESS ACK twice with the same commandId and correlationId
positiveAssertions: The command remains SUCCESS after each duplicate ACK
result_json remains the first terminal result and reply_time remains unchanged
correlation_id remains unchanged across all snapshots
negativeAssertions: No duplicate terminal transition or result overwrite is observed
